name: Dead Tide: Daylight Ring
source:
The beautiful vampire and Dread Pirate Queen Jessenia wakes up with a killer hangover and wants to spend the day lounging in the sun. Rather than burst into flame (or twinkle) under the merciless tyranny of the unforgiving solis, Jessenia saunters to and fro carefree, thanks to a mystical artifact known as the “Daylight Ring”.

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-daylight-ring.html]Official site[/url]]
